senses.gloss: to authorize, permit. Y. Keth. X, 33ᵈ bot. במַרְשׁוֹת זו את זו בשהִרְשֵׁת וכ׳ when they gave each other power of attorney, when the third wife authorized the second to go to law with the first.
units: <cite ref="Chagigah 14b:2">Ḥag. 14ᵇ</cite> <he>רבי תַּרְשֵׁינִי לומר וכ׳</he> my teacher, wilt thou permit me to say something &c.?; Y. ib. II, 77ᵃ bot.; a. e.

<cite ref="Chagigah 13a:2">Ḥag. 13ᵃ</cite> (fr. Ben Sira) <he>במה שהוּרְשֵׁיתָ התבונן וכ׳</he> speculate on that which has been given under thy control, and have nothing to do with secret things; Y. ib. II, 77ᶜ top; <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 8">Gen. R. s. 8</cite>.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 68:3">Gen. R. s. 68</cite> <he>מהיכן ה׳</he> from where did he take leave (to go away).
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 68:3">Ib.</cite> s. 39 <he>עדיין לא ה׳</he> he had not yet had the permission to go away; a. e.
